# Construct Maps

> Open-source plugin for Claude and ChatGPT that designs protein and peptide construct libraries from the literature and draws an interactive map of each design.

Design and visualize protein and peptide constructs to investigate biological function. Start from a biological question, a design goal, or constructs you already have.

## Get it

- [Source, README and install steps](https://github.com/ishant1994/construct-maps): the plugin for Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT, GPL-3.0-or-later
- [ChatGPT plugin zip](https://github.com/ishant1994/construct-maps/releases/latest/download/construct-maps-openai.zip): upload it in the Plugins tab
- [Privacy](https://github.com/ishant1994/construct-maps/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) and [terms](https://github.com/ishant1994/construct-maps/blob/main/TERMS.md)

## Case studies

- [ATP binding and hydrolysis in Hsp90 client maturation](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/hsp90/): In yeast, Hsp90 that cannot hydrolyze ATP still supports growth, but Hsp90 that cannot bind nucleotide does not. Which step does a given client protein need?
- [Residue 94 and the β7–β8 loop in S. aureus sortase A](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/sortase/): Why do substitutions at P94 raise the activity of Staphylococcus aureus sortase A, and is the β7-β8 loop involved?
- [Antibodies against HSV-1 and complement](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/hsv-complement/): Does complement engagement contribute to protection by antibodies against HSV-1 in neonatal mice, and does it do so across antibodies?
- [Pdi1: which residues bind the ribosome](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/pdi1/): Which residues of the proline-rich antimicrobial peptide Pdi1 drive its binding to the bacterial ribosome?
- [Patronin: sequence or condensation?](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/patronin/): Does the prion-like domain of Drosophila Patronin support minus-end recognition through its primary sequence or through its capacity to condense?
- [GPX4: from binder to degrader](https://ishant1994.github.io/construct-maps-demo/cases/gpx4/): How can a designed binder to human GPX4 be turned into a degrader that removes GPX4 rather than only binding it?
